name: 27320 · Reidsville, NC
findings: ZIP 27320 (Reidsville) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27320 (Reidsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27320 (Reidsville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
